statement: Peak dispatch design shall have modeled nominal capacity >= 14 completed trips per hour under declared cycle-time assumptions.
Degraded dispatch path shall have a modeled command latency <= 500 ms with 50 ms engineering reserve at review.
At least 95% of eligible accessibility pickup requests shall be served within 12 min under the approved operational sampling plan.
Modeled total traction-plus-cold auxiliary energy shall not exceed 260 kWh per operating day.
Nominal energy recovered during the 2.5-hour overnight charge window shall cover modeled daily energy demand.
A vehicle shall never be simultaneously allocated to two accepted reservations.
